content.text:
Needed: A coffee table or a box with room for the screen and the controls for Arcade coffee table
Kind of part: Any item
Top price: 70 USD

request.instructions: You plan a search of second-hand listings for one needed part or device. Write 3 to 6 search phrasings a seller might have put in a listing title: the plain name, synonyms, the part or model number in the ways it gets written, the devices it is sold for, seller wording and common misspellings; each with one line on what it finds that the others miss. A phrasing is a few words for a search box that takes words, not operators or quotes. Then one match pattern: an RE2 regular expression, applied case-insensitively to a listing's text, that a listing which fits the need matches, built from the part number with optional separators or the deciding values with their units. Keep it under 200 characters; use short gaps such as .{0,20} and classes such as [-\s]?; no lookarounds, no backreferences, no comments and no inline flags. Then the words or short phrases in a listing that rule it out: for parts, broken, not working, and any that name a variant that does not fit. Never invent a part or model number the need does not give.

content.text: {"exclusions": ["broken", "cracked glass", "not working", "upright cabinet", "tabletop mini", "wall mount"], "pattern": "arcade.{0,20}(coffee|cocktail)[-\\s]?(table|cabinet|box)", "phrasings": [{"text": "arcade coffee table", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=arcade+coffee+table", "why": "Finds the plain-name listings using coffee table wording."}, {"text": "cocktail arcade cabinet", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=cocktail+arcade+cabinet", "why": "Finds sellers using the industry term cocktail instead of coffee."}, {"text": "arcade cocktail table empty", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=arcade+cocktail+table+empty", "why": "Finds empty shells without screen and controls that others bury."}, {"text": "mame coffee table cabinet", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=mame+coffee+table+cabinet", "why": "Finds DIY MAME builder listings that never say arcade."}, {"text": "arkade coctail table", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=arkade+coctail+table", "why": "Finds misspelled listings for arkade and coctail that exact searches miss."}]}
